text: Customers and vendors hear from us, not from Lena. Clients call Lena's mobile. Without a named successor and a made introduction, relationships walk out the door with her.
PREMISE_COM_01_SUCCESSOR_NAMED: A successor contact is named for the relationship.
PREMISE_COM_02_INTRO_MADE: The introduction to the successor must already be made.
PREMISE_COM_03_RESPONSE_PROMISE: The shop promises a reply within one to two days.
PREMISE_COM_04_SENDER_SIG: The handover note needs the sender signature.

Who we take on as a client, and who says yes. Taking on a new client needs identity, credit and sanctions checks plus a partner's yes — but the paper checklist is silent on re-engaging a client it once rejected.
PREMISE_ONB_01_CLIENT_NAMED: Intake names the prospective client.
PREMISE_ONB_02_IDENTITY_VERIFIED: The client's identity must verify before acceptance.
PREMISE_ONB_03_CREDIT_PASSED: The client's credit check must pass before acceptance.
PREMISE_ONB_04_SANCTIONS_CLEAR: The client must clear the sanctions-list screen before acceptance.
PREMISE_ONB_05_PARTNER_APPROVAL: Acceptance requires an approving partner's signature.
PREMISE_ONB_06_NO_PRIOR_REJECTION: A client with a rejection on file cannot be taken on as a fresh intake; re-engagement needs owner review.
PREMISE_ONB_07_ONBOARDING_SIGNOFF: Account creation requires the onboarding lead's signature over the accepted state.
What keeps full speed and what waits for the owner. Routine work must fly while big commitments wait - the paper process either freezes everything or nothing.
PREMISE_THAW_00_VALID_DISCOUNT: The discount is a number at or above zero.
PREMISE_THAW_01_CLASS_LISTED: The decision states whether it is routine or frozen-class work.
PREMISE_THAW_02_FROZEN_NEEDS_OWNER: Frozen-class work needs the owner before anyone acts.
PREMISE_THAW_03_DISCOUNT_WITHIN_LINE: Discounts above 10 percent need the owner.
PREMISE_THAW_04_EXECUTOR_SIG: Doing the work needs the executor signature over the cleared state.

Who can spend, and who signs above $10,000. A department wants to pay a vendor: small amounts need two signatures, anything above $10,000 needs the owner's override — and the paper process stays silent on what happens when payout gets signed anyway.
PREMISE_FIN_01_DEPT_HEAD_SIG: Proposal requires a department-head signature plus a positive amount and a vendor name.
PREMISE_FIN_04_CURRENCY_SUPPORTED: Currency must be explicitly supported (USD). Uncovered currencies are refused.
PREMISE_FIN_03_VENDOR_ACTIVE: Vendor must verify as active against the approved vendor list.
PREMISE_FIN_02_CEO_OVERRIDE_REQUIRED: Amounts above 10000 require an explicit founder/CEO override signature.
PREMISE_FIN_05_FINANCE_SIG: Payout requires a finance-officer signature over the approved state.

Who approves an offer, and when a renewal needs a fresh yes. Offers need the hiring manager plus a director above $150,000 — but the paper process only covers first hires and stays silent on contractor renewals.
PREMISE_HIRE_00_POSITIVE_COMP: The offer states a positive compensation figure.
PREMISE_HIRE_01_CANDIDATE_NAMED: The offer names the candidate.
PREMISE_HIRE_02_ROLE_LISTED: The role type must be explicitly listed (employee or contractor).
PREMISE_HIRE_03_MANAGER_APPROVAL: Every offer requires the hiring manager's signature.
PREMISE_HIRE_04_OFFER_DATE_VALID: The offer date must fall inside the open hiring window.
PREMISE_HIRE_05_OVER_THRESHOLD_NEEDS_DIRECTOR: Offers above $150,000 require an explicit director override signature.
PREMISE_HIRE_06_RENEWAL_NEEDS_FRESH_APPROVAL: A contractor renewal is not a first hire: it requires a fresh re-approval signature.
PREMISE_HIRE_07_HR_EXECUTION: Issuing the offer requires the HR executor's signature over the approved state.
Core processes written down and current. Half the shop know-how lives in Lena's head - unsigned or stale write-ups block the work that depends on them.
PREMISE_DOC_01_PROCESS_NAMED: The review names the core process.
PREMISE_DOC_02_DOCUMENTED: The process must be written down.
PREMISE_DOC_03_REVIEW_CURRENT: The write-up must have been reviewed inside the current year.
PREMISE_DOC_04_OWNER_SIG: The review needs the process owner signature.
Who owns each seat when Lena cannot be reached. When Lena cannot be reached, nobody knows who may decide what - speed dies while everyone waits for her.
PREMISE_SEAT_00_POSITIVE_AMOUNT: The decision states a positive amount.
PREMISE_SEAT_01_ABSENCE_DECLARED: The absence is declared at an explicit level.
PREMISE_SEAT_02_COVER_NAMED: A covering owner is named for the seat.
PREMISE_SEAT_03_COVER_ACCEPTED: The covering owner accepts the seat in writing.
PREMISE_SEAT_04_WITHIN_ELEVATED_LIMIT: Decisions above the $10,000 elevated limit need the owner.
PREMISE_SEAT_05_EXECUTOR_SIG: Carrying out the decision needs the executor signature over the covered state.

Who gets paid, and checking the vendor is still active at payout. Paying a vendor needs an approval plus a payer — but the paper process checks the active list once at approval and stays silent when the vendor is deactivated before payout.
PREMISE_PAY_01_VENDOR_NAMED: The payment names the vendor.
PREMISE_PAY_02_POSITIVE_AMOUNT: The payment states a positive amount.
PREMISE_PAY_03_CURRENCY_SUPPORTED: Currency must be explicitly supported (USD).
PREMISE_PAY_04_VENDOR_ACTIVE: The vendor must still verify as active at payout time, even when the approval signature is valid.
PREMISE_PAY_05_APPROVAL: Payment requires a purchase approver's signature.
PREMISE_PAY_06_OVER_THRESHOLD_NEEDS_CONTROLLER: Payments above $25,000 require an explicit controller override signature.
PREMISE_PAY_07_PAYER_EXECUTION: Releasing the payment requires the payer's signature over the approved state.
The weekly numbers that must stay healthy. The week Lena retires, cash sits at 6 weeks of runway and nobody is obliged to tell anyone - red numbers nobody owns.
PREMISE_NUM_01_CASH_FLOOR: Cash runway must hold at 8 weeks or more.
PREMISE_NUM_02_MARGIN_FLOOR: Gross margin must hold at 15 percent or more.
PREMISE_NUM_03_NO_SUSTAINED_RED: Red numbers two weeks running force owner review.
PREMISE_NUM_04_REVIEWER_SIGNED: The weekly review needs the numbers reviewer signature.
